# scenario echo_and_own_message: what the core told the UI, and where it ended up.
# Recorded from internal/irc + internal/state. Regenerate with
# `go test ./internal/transcript -update`, and read doc.go before you do.

stream registration
	conn "connecting"
	conn "ready"
	conn "registering"
	rail
	self <eco>
	status server "- irc.test Message of the Day -"
	status server "- testsrv, a scripted fake server"
	status server "Connected! You are eco"
	status server "End of /MOTD command."
	status server "This server was created at the beginning of the test"
	status server "Welcome to the TestNet IRC Network eco"
	status server "Your host is irc.test, running version testsrv-1"

stream 0 C: join #eco

stream 2 S: :eco!eco@test JOIN #eco / :irc.test 332 eco #eco :topic / :irc.test 353 eco = #eco :@alice eco / :irc.test 366 eco #eco :End of /NAMES list.
	members #eco "alice(@),eco"
	rail
	status #eco "You joined #eco"
	topic #eco "topic"

stream 5 C: say #eco "hello there"
	msg #eco <eco> [self] "hello there"

stream 7 S: @%LABEL%;msgid=e1 :eco!eco@test PRIVMSG #eco :hello there
	resolve #eco "e1"

stream 8 C: say #eco "again"
	msg #eco <eco> [self] "again"

stream 10 S: @%LABEL%;msgid=e2 :eco!eco@test PRIVMSG #eco :again
	resolve #eco "e2"

stream 11 C: me #eco "waves"
	msg #eco <eco> [action,self] "waves"

stream 13 S: @%LABEL%;msgid=e3 :eco!eco@test PRIVMSG #eco :\x01ACTION waves\x01
	resolve #eco "e3"

stream 14 S: @msgid=e4 :eco!eco@test PRIVMSG #eco :sent from my phone
	msg #eco <eco> [self] "sent from my phone"

stream 15 S: @msgid=e5 :eco!eco@test PRIVMSG #eco :\x01ACTION waves from my phone\x01
	msg #eco <eco> [action,self] "waves from my phone"

state #eco topic="topic" modes="" key="" members=[alice(@) eco]
	status #eco "You joined #eco"
	msg #eco <eco> [self] "hello there"
	msg #eco <eco> [self] "again"
	msg #eco <eco> [action,self] "waves"
	msg #eco <eco> [self] "sent from my phone"
	msg #eco <eco> [action,self] "waves from my phone"

state server topic="" modes="" key="" members=[]
	status server "Welcome to the TestNet IRC Network eco"
	status server "Your host is irc.test, running version testsrv-1"
	status server "This server was created at the beginning of the test"
	status server "- irc.test Message of the Day -"
	status server "- testsrv, a scripted fake server"
	status server "End of /MOTD command."
	status server "Connected! You are eco"
